alex: Quick weekly capacity pulse — attaching the forecast sheet: https://redwood.sheets/weekly-capacity-1767 :point_right: TL;DR below

maria: linked, thanks. can you call out the regions with the biggest delta vs forecast?

alex: sure — short bullets:
- EU-west: headroom ~8% vs target 7% (ok)
- US-west: sustained 88–92% peak (risk window 17:00–21:00 UTC)
- APAC (ap-southeast): 18% idle but high fail rates on provisioning (~6% node prep failures) causing slow ramp not true spare capacity
- us-east: healthy 12% buffer

sam: provisioning failures in apac — is that network or disk prep? last week looked like image pull timeouts
ingrid: we saw increased image-pull latency from our private registry at 03:00-05:00 local, likely peering flaps. infra ticket open: INF-3198

jon: can we shift burst capacity while infra triages? prefer avoid impacting us-west tail latency

alex: proposal: temporary routing policy for next 48h — route non-SLA background batch to apac preemptible pool and increase preemptible cap from 30% -> 45% in apac. Also enable cross-region fallback for low-priority jobs to eu-west during us-west peak window.

maria: cost question — increasing preemptible cap raises hourly risk but reduces on-demand spins. estimation?

alex: rough calc in sheet, snippet:```
scenario: 48h shift
- expected on-demand delta: -320 GPU hours
- added preemptible risk: +45% preemptions (expected 12 restarts)
- estimated net cost delta: -$2.1k over 48h
```

sam: +1 to shifting non-critical traffic. we should gate by queue latency SLOs first. if queue latency > 250ms for p99, cancel shift.

capacity-bot: Forecast v3 uploaded by alex at 1767894321. Change set: preemptible caps, routing-policy temp.

ingrid: infra action: INF-3198 investigating registry peering with vendor. early blamelist: cross-region peering degrade + BGP flap ~03:10 UTC. I'll post logs here when available.

jon: ops action: i'll run a canary of the routing policy at 18:00 UTC (small subset of batch routes). tagging @maria for cost watch.

maria: will watch billing alerts and set a soft cap. if spend delta > $3k, rollback.

alex: decision: proceed with canary at 18:00 UTC. full 48h shift only if canary p95 latency < 200ms and no increased error rate.

sam: i'll add a dashboard panel for queue p99/p95 and preemptible restart rate. ETA 2h.

ingrid: INF-3198 update: uploaded registry logs to the ticket, looks like a peering maintenance at cloud provider starting 02:50 UTC. Raising incident if we see >5% provisioning failures over next 6h.

jon: noted. I'll coordinate the canary and hold the runbook.

alex: thanks team — action items summarized: 1) canary routing @18:00 UTC (jon) 2) dashboard panels (sam) 3) cost guardrails (maria) 4) infra triage & incident (ingrid). I'll close loop after canary, post final decision. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — ping me when canary starts.

capacity-bot: Reminder: weekly capacity review scheduled Friday 15:00 UTC — add results to deck.
